title: How to Make Blood Look Real

author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam sits down with Cinema Relics' Dan Lanigan in his collection archive to examine three memorable blaster props from science fiction films. It's another opportunity for Adam to have an audience with a Zorg Industries ZF-1 from The Fifth Element, the sci-fi blaster prop Adam knows best. Adam and Dan also take a look at the unique design of the alien pod weapon from Galaxy Quest and the futuristic railgun from the 90s action movie Eraser!

Learn more about Cinema Relics prop investigations at: https://www.youtube.com/@cinemarelics/videos
Adam Savage Meets Indiana Jones' Original Golden Idol: https://youtu.be/8nBzTC1Cq7g
